priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, or immediately before activating Berserk/Incarnation.
Activate Berserk or Incarnation when Tiger's Fury is active.
Use Feral Frenzy or Frantic Frenzy when at 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Cast Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury is active, ideally immediately after a Finisher.
Use damage trinkets and potions during Berserk or when Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Primal Wrath at 5 Combo Points if the Rip bleed is refreshable or has less than 6.5 seconds remaining.
Cast Ferocious Bite if Apex Predator's Craving or Ravage is active.
In AoE, cast Ferocious Bite at 5 Combo Points if Primal Wrath/Rip is already active on targets to trigger Rampant Ferocity.
Apply and maintain Rake on 2 to 4 targets to spread Wildstalker vines.
Maintain Moonfire on targets if Lunar Inspiration is talented.
Use Swipe when Clearcasting is active if there are more than 2 targets.
Use Swipe when Sudden Ambush is active if there are 7 or more targets.
Use Shred as a builder for exactly 2 targets if Panther's Guile is talented.
Use Swipe as the default builder for 3 or more targets to generate Combo Points.
Use Regrowth when Predatory Swiftness is active to maintain health or bloodtalons if applicable.
